name: Freezer-Friendly One-Pot Meal
instructions: Choose a saucy, stew-like, or grain-based one-pot dish -- these freeze and reheat far better than anything with crisp textures.
Cook a double batch in the same time it takes to make one, since the pot is already out and hot.
Cool the extra portion fully before freezing to avoid ice crystals and preserve texture.
Label with the date and reheat gently from frozen (stovetop or microwave, stirring often) rather than thawing on the counter.
